BlueQubit, in collaboration with partners, received a $1.5 million grant from the U.S. Department of Energy’s Genesis Mission program. The funding is earmarked to develop and accelerate AI‑driven quantum error‑correction techniques, enhancing the reliability and scalability of quantum computing systems. This investment supports the broader DOE goal of advancing next‑generation quantum technologies.
